[b]Version 1.3.2 - 1-13-2022[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where The Locker and Retaliation did not correctly formulate damage conditionals

notes.title: VERSION 1.2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm happy to announce a brand new update for Daughter of Essence, featuring a long list of changes, improvements and new features.

I'm grateful for all your support this year, and I hope you enjoy.

Best,
Nym, Lead Developer


[b]Version 1.2 - 12-22-2021[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new armored Mercy portraits and sprites (normal, fishing, riding and battle sprites)!
[*] Added Steam Achievements!
[*] Added new gauges and an improved HUD to the final siege for better transparency
[*] Updated a number of different scenes with new dialogue
[*] Performance Improvements and updated engine
[*] Added new voice lines to some of the endings
[*] Added a plugin to halt the in-built fast-forward function of RPG Maker during certain cut-scenes (I believe fast-forward was causing image-related crashes on some lower-spec machines. Hopefully we will see much less of these now)
[*] Marlan’s Guard-Breaker now correctly removes Stone Spines, making the ejderha fight nicer
[*] Fixed an issue where Feodor’s unconscious form would vanish after leaving the Aster manor
[*] Fixed some passability issues
[*] Fixed an issue where Beatrix scenes could play while in the guest room next door
[*] Delilah’s room will now be open immediately after she’s recruited
[*] Fixed an issue where Naomi could either miss with Lotus Shot, or else use it on the wrong target
[*] Fixed an issue where a line of dialogue could be repeated twice by two separate enemies
[*] Van Ritter and company are gone from Witchdale after confronting them
[*] Fixed an issue where cocoa beans weren’t previously healing
[*] Fixed an issue where the chocolate bar wasn’t properly learned from the recipe book
[*] Slightly rebalanced final siege values
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dietrich & Moon scene could be triggered after one of them fell in the siege
[*] Fixed an issue where the first Vincent & Gertrude scene could be triggered after ch. 8
[*] Fixed some portrait-related crashes
[*] Implemented ShadyCorner integration
[*] Fixed an issue where “Wound Essence” was lost after a respec
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Version 1.1.1!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I'm very pleased to announce that the game is not only being updated with a number of additions, improvements & fixes, we're also adding a completely new game branch: [b]Accessibility Mode[/b]!

You can opt in to Accessibility Mode like a beta by right clicking on Daughter of Essence and going to Properties > Betas, and it makes a number of adjustments to the game for people who struggle with the faster QTEs or the difficulty of boss encounters. You may also prefer this version if you are less interested in planning your builds and worrying about stats and would prefer things be a little less challenging.

[i]Note: You can carry over your old save to accessibility mode, but it will not retroactively modify your saved characters' stats. You cannot, however, carry over a save file from accessibility mode to the standard build.[/i]

[b]ACCESSIBILITY MODE FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Doubled base health for Mercy, Orus and Beatrix
[*] All HP recovery items now have higher flat rate increases
[*] Timer doubled on all fishing events
[*] Combat QTEs removed, damage formulae are now flat
[*] Mercy starts with 10 more Attack and Spirit
[*] Earth Vial restores 50% HP on resurrection instead of 30%
[*] Infinite Stat/Skill Respecs Available
[/list]

notes.title: DoE Update 1.06 (March 23)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is the 5th patch since launch and since this one makes a couple of small changes, I thought I'd make a short post.

The walkthrough is updated all the way to the end, and I've made a change to how a couple of passive NSFW scenes trigger. They're now behind choice menus like most other scenes. Beyond that, just a handful of minor bug-fixes. Enjoy!

[b]Version 1.06 - 3-23-2021[/b]
Updated the walkthrough
[list]
[*] A couple of passive NSFW scenes have been placed behind choice menus rather than autoplaying, so they can be avoided if that is your preference
[*] Fixed a move speed error after interacting with the mysterious chest in the cove
[*] Fixed a couple of passability issues at Fort Wilkes
[*] Fixed some text-runoff on the credits screen
[*] Fixed some outdated fishing spots
[*] Fixed a passability issue in Grey Clarion
[*] Fixed a passability issue in Hawk’s Keep
[/list]
